notes.title: 🍆 Smutty Scrolls Early Access is here for you!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36029060/3f45cf8d595df5169b92e6dc0dc5b517d40e7a7d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39400124/5e21d9f23d6c6edfac3abe23ea82bf8693c7dba3.png[/img]

[b]Heyho, you funky sexy puzzle adventurer![/b]

It's time... for slime!
You're smart. You're handsome. You're the cutest green slime ever.
You are more than ready to uncover the [b]lewd secrets[/b] of the Smutty Scrolls!

Early Access is available today (with 10% off)!
Pick up your copy of Smutty Scrolls now and feel free to leave a review, my man!

[u]In this version:[/u]
[list]
[*] Date Vendita, one of Lim-Lim's best friends. You already know her from the shops in the game - now it's time to learn more about her back story!
[*] Unlock ALL endings in the game :)
[/list]

[u]Content coming soon:[/u]
[list]
[*] Several new VN scenes
[*] The first part of a new level (Dungeon Maestro)
[*] A new hot-tempered member of Madame Mouri's university course
[/list]

♥️ A huge, HUGE THANK YOU the size of a freaking mountain goes out to all the people who helped make this game possible:
My awesome and sexy Patrons. You're the reason the game exists in the first place!
My talented magical team partner Oni. You're just the best!
My smart and caring publisher Flynn. It's a pleasure to work with you!
Everybody who played, commented, liked, shared and favorited the game, everybody who helped with advice and feedback, every dev that shared their knowledge. Thank you so much!

And now... go and play the game :D
Stay funky,
Dez

notes.title: Official Game Guide & Update
notes.content:
Heyho, you funky sexy lockdown lover!

How are you doing? We've squashed some bugs so you have a better game experience - thanks a ton for reporting them!

Fixed Bugs:
- Adventure Babe Bug reported by pocketlight
- Apple Bug reported by Ætherfox
- Clipboard Bug reported by CrispyWater
- missing Emoji reported by CrispyWater & ZelosZalis
- wrong Hint reported by ZelosZalis & TheGalacticAmethyst
- missing Dog numbers reported by gohan552203 & tylana
- wrong pillow text reported by WeissRook
- some minor bugs discovered by Dez

Thank you all for your help and support!

One more thing: The Official Game Guide is finished!
It's player-friendly and uses spoilers, so you can decide if you want the whole solution or just a little hint.

Have fun lewding up your lockdown and stay funky!
Your Team Tailnut devs Dezue & OniGiri
